title: The Lucent River
kicker: A luminous river whose blue night glow lets travelers keep time and whose waters are sold, mythologized, healed by, and hunted in.
hook: A luminous river whose blue night glow lets travelers keep time and whose waters are sold, mythologized, healed by, and hunted in.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Lucent River carries blue light through Sablewood like a road that refuses to become a road.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The water carries its own blue light, bright enough at night to read by, so the river looks like a road that refused to become one. A small rope ferry hauls across the current. Tiny offerings sit on the bank where the water bends. In the shallows the glowing...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Ferry folk grill glass-fish caught straight from the bright water, sweet and faintly luminous, and sell river-cress by the handful. Pilgrims buy little bottles of the glow, which is mostly algae and entirely hope.
